summary: Create a git Repository resource (e.g. site-settings with spec.type git and url), apply it with flightctl, confirm ACCESSIBLE True with `flightctl get repository/site-settings`, then add a GitConfigProviderSpec entry in the device spec.config with gitRef repository, targetRevision and path.
questions: How do I create a Git Repository resource in Edge Manager?
How do I check that Edge Manager can access my Git repo?
How do I apply Git-based configuration to a device?

answer_card.title: Device configuration from Git
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: flightctl.io/v1alpha1
kind: Repository
metadata: {name: site-settings}
spec:
  type: git
  url: https://github.com/<org>/<repo>.git
```
```bash
flightctl apply -f site-settings-repo.yaml
flightctl get repository/site-settings   # ACCESSIBLE True
```
```yaml
# Device spec
spec:
  config:
  - name: example-site
    configType: GitConfigProviderSpec
    gitRef:
      repository: site-settings
      targetRevision: production
      path: /etc/example-site
```
The root `/` is not writable on bootc systems, so target a writable path.
